binding.identity_rule: address is not identity; verify current canonical profile, leaf, family/gateway, issuer, floors and selected registered-device route before start; never copy a key to satisfy this mapping
binding.fresh_live_verification: NOT_RUN; required during authorized deployment preflight

backend_security: system TLS roots + IP SAN validation, no proxy/redirect, two fixed RPC paths only

authority_one_shot.input: new private invocation directory containing public seed.json and existing gateway public certificate PEM
authority_one_shot.output: new signed locator.json, copied atomically to matching entry invocation
authority_one_shot.mutation: no migration, identity creation, key generation, admission or registry writes

secret_custody.issuer_key: stays at existing RU authority; not read by entry or packager
secret_custody.gateway_private_key: stays on NL in existing private gateway profile
secret_custody.oauth: existing NL provider.env; never copied into artifacts, argv or receipts

preconditions: authorized readback confirms selected node/host, active backend handler version and user eligibility

resolve /etc/fc-canonical-pinned-venv/locator.json on NL1; configured /etc/fc-canonical-pinned-venv/profile.json must still be its current profile and match the running gateway; stop on mismatch, never copy keys or rewrite existing locators
gateway profile certificate, current CRL/floors, family and gateway match existing issuer and APK ControlTrust
normal authority HTTPS verifies from NL without custom roots or insecure flags
existing dedicated service user can read gateway profile/provider env; preserve their ownership and mode
new invocation path does not exist; no concurrent field entry; installed package hashes match receipt
user reachable on an agreed APK document delivery channel and ready before entry starts
unchanged_services: existing maintenance, renewal and sync units
nginx, AWG and other data-plane services
stop: systemctl stop cold-provision-entry@<same-invocation>.service; verify inactive, its MainPID gone and stopped.json; preserve invocation evidence
rollback: stop only new entry; remove only its unit/package after evidence retention if requested; do not modify existing service configuration
room_deletion: NOT_VERIFIED; disconnect is not provider object deletion
network_changes: none; no new listener, forwarding rule, public route or host firewall modification
phone_and_catalog_changes: none in preparation; separate authorized handoff, never automatic install or public updater publication
